title: Kingfisher
description: One tap to fly. The original one-tap bird, rebuilt faithfully: a 288x512 world at thirty ticks a second, gravity of one pixel a tick, a flap that lifts exactly 45 pixels, pipes 52 wide scrolling four pixels a tick with a 100-pixel gap placed anywhere in a 142-pixel band, a point when the bird's middle passes the pipe's middle, a nose that holds 20 degrees up after every tap and then pitches over. Difficulty is constant, like the original: the randomness is the difficulty. Pixel art in the original's language (two-by-two pixels, a dark outline on everything, green pipes, a striped verge), day and night, three plumages, medals at 10, 20, 30 and 40, and a score board. The rules run in Node, where a planner has to clear two hundred pipes on every seed.
